unavailable: This request is not available in your Inbox.

waiting.label: Waiting for your decision
waiting.next: Review this request in your Inbox.

executed.label: Authorized and completed
executed.next: Your assistant can continue. No further approval is needed for this request.

failed.label: Authorized, but did not complete
failed.next: Your assistant must check the failure before trying again.

not-run.label: Authorized, but did not run
not-run.next: Your assistant must resolve the recorded blocker before trying again.

expired.label: Approval window closed
expired.next: Your assistant can check whether the work is still needed and send a fresh request.

declined.label: Declined
declined.next: This request will not run. Tell your assistant if you want a different action.

unknown.label: Approved; result not confirmed
unknown.next: Your assistant must check the target before retrying. Approval alone does not prove completion.

recovery.credential-unavailable: The original connection is no longer active. Your assistant must check its connection before retrying.
recovery.consent-changed: The connection's authorization changed. Review its access before retrying.
recovery.scope-insufficient: The connection no longer has permission for this action. Review its access before retrying.
recovery.arguments-not-provable: The saved request could not be verified. Your assistant must check the target before sending a fresh request.
recovery.no-pending-call: The original request could not be found. Your assistant must check the target before sending a fresh request.
recovery.task-bound: Your assistant must check the task that owns this request.
recovery.task-not-waiting: The task has moved on. Your assistant must check its current result before retrying.
recovery.task-waiting-again: The task continued and needs another decision. Review the next request in your Inbox.
recovery.expired: The approval window closed before execution. Your assistant must check the target before sending a fresh request.
